answer: Proposal: meter rewards by attested hardware, not account. Each agent's enclave must whisper a manufacturer-signed device serial (its pigment) to a registry; one credential per serial per epoch, issuer bond slashed on duplicates. Per-credential reward is capped below that device's per-epoch rental, so k identities cost k·rent and return at most k·cap < k·rent: extra keys lose money, and the nectar pool is never worth farming. Assume unforgeable serials and an honest registry. Leaks: spoofing, issuer collusion, cheap aging hardware.
